name: How do I choose the right contractor for a seismic upgrade?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a seismic upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for a seismic upgrade, consider their experience with similar projects, their understanding of local building codes, and their ability to provide comprehensive project coordination. It is crucial to choose a licensed and insured contractor with a proven track record. Hometelligent Inc. specializes in seismic retrofits within the Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, and Emeryville areas, offering expertise in local regulations and structural requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with experience in seismic upgrades, knowledge of local codes, and strong project coordination skills.
